notes: This robot builds to WebAssembly (wasm32-wasip1), as the hosted builder does, and runs on the Wasmtime host metered by fuel, which counts the same on every computer. Set "target": "native" in bot.json to build with your C compiler instead. A native build plays Open only: Standard refuses it. Other platforms build natively until their SDK carries the WebAssembly host.

checks.label: clipspy Python package
checks.hint: Activate a Python virtual environment, then run python3 -m pip install clipspy.

notes: CLIPS uses Python 3 and clipspy (qualified with 1.0.6), installed into the Python environment you run the kit from. A standalone clips executable does not replace clipspy.
Install MiniZinc with the Gecode solver and fzn-gecode on PATH. Python 3 hosts the core; both minizinc and fzn-gecode execute locally.
Install GForth (gforth on PATH); Python 3 hosts the core binding and talks to the GForth process.
Install GNU APL 2.0 (apl on PATH); Python 3 hosts the core binding and talks to the APL process. Other APL implementations are not qualified.
Install CBQN 0.12.0 (bqn on PATH); Node hosts the core and the persistent CBQN process. Other BQN interpreters are not qualified.

checks.label: LLVM with the riscv32 target, and ld.lld
checks.hint: Install LLVM 17 or later with clang and lld: the LLVM release for your platform, brew install llvm lld on macOS, or apt install clang lld on Ubuntu and Debian. Set CLUNKYARD_CLANG and CLUNKYARD_LD_LLD if they are not on PATH.

notes: A RISC-V robot is assembly source, assembled and linked by your LLVM and packed into the Clunkyard RISC-V machine, which runs on the Wasmtime host metered by fuel, the same on every computer, as hosted. A local match uses its Standard fuel budget (rates/s3.json).
Install AssemblyScript (asc on PATH), for example npm install --global assemblyscript. The recipe uses AssemblyScript 0.28.20.
Install wasi-sdk 34 and set WASI_SDK_PATH to it (its package installs it in /opt/wasi-sdk). Its Clang builds the robot for wasm32 without a C library.
Install the wasm32-unknown-unknown Rust target, normally with rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown. No WASI runtime is needed.
Install Zig 0.17.1; the freestanding build recipe uses its flags.
